name: @agentmemory/mcp

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Search past session observations for relevant context. Use when you need to recall what happened in previous sessions, find past decisions, or look up how a file was modified before.

format.description: Result format: full, compact, or narrative (default full)

token_budget.description: Optional token budget to trim returned results

tools.name: memory_save
tools.description: Explicitly save an important insight, decision, or pattern to long-term memory.

content.description: The insight or decision to remember

type.description: Memory type: pattern, preference, architecture, bug, workflow, or fact

project.description: Stable canonical project identifier this memory belongs to (e.g. a slug, UUID, or registry key). Must match the value used when the session was started. Do not use filesystem paths or ad-hoc display names — those change across machines and will silently break project scoping.

agentId.description: Agent identity to scope this memory to. When set, agent-scoped recall and search only surface it for the same agentId. Omit for shared memory.

tools.name: memory_sessions
tools.description: List recent sessions with their status and observation counts.

tools.name: memory_smart_search
tools.description: Hybrid semantic+keyword search with progressive disclosure.

tools.name: memory_export
tools.description: Export all memory data as JSON.

tools.name: memory_audit
tools.description: View the audit trail of memory operations.

tools.name: memory_governance_delete
tools.description: Delete specific memories with audit trail.
